author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 겨울철 전국의 호수, 하천, 하구 같은 습지에서 흔히 보이는 겨울철새로, 작은 무리를 지어 지낸다. 잠수해 물고기, 조개류, 갑각류 등을 잡아먹는다. 유라시아 대륙의 아한대에서 번식하고 유럽, 카스피해, 인도 북부, 중국 동부, 한국, 일본에서 월동한다.

art.subject: Smew (Mergellus albellus), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean lakes and rivers from November to March: mostly white plumage; a black patch around the eye extending forward to the bill base; a short white crest with a black V-shaped line at its rear on the nape; two thin black lines curving across the side of the breast; black back; scapulars white marked with black lines; flanks pale grey finely vermiculated; tail grey. Short dark grey bill with a slight hook; dark eye; grey legs.
art.pose: swimming on a quiet lake, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter lake with calm open water and dry reeds along the shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: mostly white, black patch around the eye, short white crest with a black nape line, black back, two thin black lines on the breast side, short dark grey bill
adult female, side view swimming: chestnut-brown crown and nape, sharply white cheeks, chin and foreneck, dark lores, grey body, short dark grey bill
art.build: Small, compact diving duck, about 42cm, smaller than a Mallard, with a large head, short crest and short neck. Bill short and narrow, dark grey, much shorter than the head, with a small hook at the tip; far shorter than the bills of other mergansers. Legs grey, set far back. Floats buoyantly and dives often. In flight looks black and white, with a white oval patch on the inner forewing.
avoid: Do not paint a long red bill; that belongs to Red-breasted Merganser (Mergus serrator) and Common Merganser (Mergus merganser).
Do not leave out the male's black eye patch or the black lines on its breast.
Do not paint the female's head grey or dark brown all over; she has a chestnut cap with sharply white cheeks and throat.
Do not give a long shaggy crest; the male's crest is short and neat.
